lines.trans: I am not going to help you! Do you understand that this is kindergarten?
You found a fine time and place! What difference does it make to you?
I cannot sleep in peace! This old man is stealing the girl's best years.
What, did you fall in love with her?
No! Or yes. What difference does it make? Help me, I beg you.
No, I said no.
Look, I got down on my knees! I am kissing your feet.
Don't kiss anything of mine! Arkady, stop it, I just came in from the street!
Please, help me! I will keep kissing them anyway.
Ugh, give me my feet back, I say! That's it, enough, stop! I agree.
Hooray, the little trick works! The governor taught me this.
He begs the president like that every time. So that they don't fire him from his job.
Marina, come to me! I took a pill today.
So today I will be like a young hero!
Blood pressure? It's nothing, you just make my head spin.
Oh, what is that noise out there? I don't know, let's go look.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
What, did you fall in love with her?
He fell in love at first sight.

встать.gloss: to stand up, to get up

meanings.en: to stand up, to get up (out of bed)

examples.text: Кто первый встал, того и тапки.
examples.trans: First come, first served (whoever got up first gets the slippers).

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
a brave person; also the main character of a story

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

meanings.en: 'голову оторвать' = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.
The governor has come to the town.
Those make your blood pressure rise.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: belonging to children or from childhood

examples.trans: This is an old children's book.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: I'm not going to steal a dog.

meanings.note: голова кружится = one's head is spinning, one feels dizzy

examples.trans: The leaves are whirling in the wind.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world
на его место = in his place

examples.text: Молодой человек, как на тест-драйв записаться?
examples.trans: Young man, how do I sign up for a test drive?
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.
He taught me how to swim.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось
Russian uses one word for both
hesitation, at the start of a sentence
agrees in gender and case with the noun

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)
to give away, to hand over

examples.trans: He will hand over the money.

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.

meanings.note: the person helped is in the dative: 'помогать маме' = to help mum
понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

meanings.note: head of a country or a company

examples.trans: The president is speaking on TV.
Who is the president of the company?
Security will be here any moment.

принять.gloss: to receive, to see (a visitor); to accept

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness
работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром
almost always in 'всё равно' = it doesn't matter; мне всё равно = I don't care
Какая разница? = What difference does it make?
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Сейчас через сад и мост — и дома.
examples.trans: Right now through the park and the bridge, and I'm home.
The children are walking in the town park.

снять.gloss: to film, to photograph; to take off; to rent

meanings.en: to film, to take a photo/video of

examples.text: Я сняла пьяного соседа на телефон.
examples.trans: I filmed a drunk neighbour on my phone.
He took off his coat by the door.

meanings.note: almost always the short form: я согласен (man), я согласна (woman)

examples.trans: This old man is sitting on the bench.
The old man told an interesting story.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: на улице холодно = it's cold outside

examples.text: На Московской улице перевернули ящики с мусором.
examples.trans: On Moskovskaya Street someone tipped over the rubbish bins.

фу.gloss: drop it! (to a dog); ugh, yuck

meanings.note: impersonal, + genitive: денег не хватило = there wasn't enough money
целую! = kisses! (at the end of a call or message)

examples.trans: I'm calling to say thank you.

examples.text: Ты можешь убрать весь этот шум?
examples.trans: Can you cut out all this noise?
Where is this noise coming from?

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
